value.rationale: Equal mean dry-spell intervals and event frequency are an ecologically motivated comparison. The exact two-reversal phenomenon changes the direction of the effect of drought temporal variability as mean drought duration changes, with a unique sharp half-gap threshold for every pair of biological rates. The one-vs-two biochemical maturation stage boundary is structural rather than an arbitrary numeric slice. It is a transparent mathematical benchmark for rewetting carbon pulse hypotheses, not claimed as a real-soil prediction.
